The '''Planetarium''' was a long chamber located at the base of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Situated next to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Tower's main entrance]] on the first level, it contained large [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] replicas of several [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] bodies.

==History==
Erected in the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the Temple Planetarium was unique due to its use of physical representations as opposed to those strictly made of [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. In use for nearly a millennium, the Planetarium was slightly expanded when a [[Statue of Qui-Gon Jinn|large statue]] of the slain [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was erected in a small rotunda off the main chamber.<ref name="TFU" />

After the three years of fighting that made up the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Temple was invaded and routed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The Planetarium was badly damaged and left in ruins, a testament to the might of the resurgent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].<ref name="TFU" />

Nearly [[2 ABY/Legends|two decades]] after the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a small force at the Temple's entrances. Stationed within the Planetarium were several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Purge trooper]]s capable of dealing with any Jedi who might attempt to enter the complex. In search of clues to his heritage, the former [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] entered the Temple's Planetarium and began to decimate the troopers there. While the room sustained even more damage, Starkiller's visit was brief and the room returned to its dormant state.<ref name="TFU" />

Untouched throughout most of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Planetarium would eventually be destroyed when the five spires of the Temple collapsed during the catastrophe with the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and were cleared away.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> While the Temple was [[New Jedi Temple|rebuilt]] by the order of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], it is unknown if the Planetarium was restored in the structure; though the old blueprints were followed extremely closely with only minor changes.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

==Layout==
Located on the first floor of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]], the Planetarium was situated off of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Spire's main entrance]]. Accessed via a hall that leading from the left side of the Spire Entrance the room wrapped around nearly a quarter of the central shaft that made up the heart of the tower. A long windowed hall, the center of the room was dedicated to the massive [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorpad]] and [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that created the planetary display. Several smaller [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] globe orbited a larger central one with small holo-planets and other satellites buzzing around.<ref name="TFU" />

Along the inner wall of the main space were balconies which displayed statues and artifacts of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; expansive bas-reliefs were hung under the balcony's banister. [[Heritage tapestry]] hung from the vaulted ceiling, and large tablets declared the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. Sunken areas near the windowed exterior wall were littered with podiums upon which busts of some of the Order's greatest minds rested, along with vases and urns collected from across the galaxy. [[Meditation/Legends|Meditation]] benches were stacked neatly in areas for use by Jedi wishing to focus on the energies in the chamber.<ref name="TFU" />

At the end of the hall was a raised rotunda filled with stained-glass windows; a towering statue of Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was erected in the center of the room. Immediately before the rotunda was an low, wide-mouthed access portal which led to a narrow hall that winded around the central shaft, ending in a balcony overlooking the open space.<ref name="TFU" />
